alignment_summary: The three codebooks show strong agreement on core operations: finding common denominators, borrowing/regrouping, and handling final-result processing. The main alignment challenge is granularity: Expert A separates whole-part subtraction and fraction subtraction, Expert B combines subtraction of aligned parts but separates simplification from final composition, and Expert C separates fraction subtraction but bundles whole-number rewriting and part alignment. Every skill_id was assigned exactly once, with several 1/3 concepts arising from one expert splitting a broader concept that another expert bundled.
